source.author: stat
source.text: iam murmura serpunt plebis Echioniae, tacitumque a principe vulgus dissidet, et, qui mos populis, venturus amatur.
source.text_original: iam murmura serpunt / plebis Echioniae, tacitumque a principe vulgus / dissidet, et, qui mos populis, venturus amatur.
source.text_english: Already the murmurs of the Echionian people are spreading, and the silent common crowd is at odds with its leader, and, as is the custom with peoples, the man who is about to come is loved.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: populumne levem veterique tyranno infensum atque olim miserantes Aesona patres advocet?
reuse.text_original: populumne levem veterique tyranno / infensum atque olim miserantes Aesona patres / advocet?
reuse.text_english: Should he summon a fickle people, hostile to the old tyrant, and the fathers of Aeson, who long ago had pity?
